criteria.rationale: Additive: every new field on an existing artifact is omitempty, so a bundle or attestation written before this change marshals byte-identically and keeps its digest. The band summary and the declared forecast stay out of digestReviewPlan, proven by TestABMProgressiveReviewBandsDoNotChangePlanIdentity, so no sealed review is superseded. structural-causality binds only bundles sealed after it existed. One deliberate observable change: narrower public-contract classification in assess design, which is a defect fix and is recorded as one.

POSE.md, the pt-BR manual and both scaffold copies document bands, the declared forecast, the protected baseline, observed structure and the mapping contract. The review-plan and review-attestation schemas publish the new fields as optional, CLI help names --mapping and the MCP tool description names all of it. Manual locale parity and embedded distribution parity gates pass.

Offline preserved, no network, no writes during planning. Both new Git reads are bounded and conditional: the protected baseline reads at most 1 MiB per contract file and only when the scope touches one, and the structural observation runs only when an adopted profile selects on it, so a repository that did not opt in pays nothing. Every failure path degrades to a reported state - unreadable base, missing index, undecidable selector - rather than to a claim.

The change set matches the declared artifacts, 39 claims reconciled against 39 Git-observed paths. Two adjacent defects were corrected inside the blast radius and recorded rather than bundled silently: the over-broad api/ prefix in the structural detector and the integration producer that did not name the new corpus. ScopeDigest tolerance for an absent profile is a coupling the protected baseline forced, and is recorded. Nothing unrelated was refactored.

One finding, raised and fixed inside this review: the protected baseline passed a revision read from the delivery-integrity index straight into a Git argument, where an option-shaped value would have been read as a flag and a symbolic name would have made the protected contract depend on where a ref points today. It now requires an immutable object name and reports the change unprotected otherwise, covered by TestABMProtectedBaselineRefusesANonImmutableRevision and proven to fail without the check. Also reviewed and sound: reviewer-supplied mapping values are quoted before reaching a message, a basis ref must match a closed pattern before use, profile refs are slug-validated before a path is built, and structural facts carry digests rather than manifest content.
